---
title: vue-vanilla
description: Vue 3 client with native scoped <style> CSS.
---

Branch: `template/vue-vanilla` — Vue 3 with native scoped CSS in
`<style>` blocks, no CSS framework.

- Each `.vue` SFC uses `<style scoped>` — Vue's compiler adds `data-v-xxxx`
  attribute selectors, preventing style leaks.
- Use `:deep()` for selectors targeting slotted content from child
  components. Shell wrappers (Layout, AuthLayout) use unscoped `<style>`
  for slot content and `[data-theme="dark"]` ancestor selectors.
- `styles.css` holds only global base: design tokens, reset, and shared UI
  primitives (`.btn`, `.badge`, `.panel`, `.table`, `.avatar`).
- The Vue plugin (`vue-plugin.ts`) compiles each `<style>` block with
  `@vue/compiler-sfc`'s `compileStyle`, writes to temp files, and Bun.build
  bundles all styles into one output stylesheet.

```bash
bun create dulak@latest my-app --template vue-vanilla
```
